items.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally
items.note: Key insight: compute at inference time is a different scaling axis than training compute. Directly relevant for our agentic chatbot — explore allocating more tokens to reasoning steps.

items.title: LiteLLM — Unified LLM API Gateway
items.note: Could replace our custom routing logic in Business4AI. Handles Claude, GPT-4o, Bedrock all with one interface.

items.title: vLLM — High-throughput LLM Serving
items.note: PagedAttention is brilliant — treats KV cache like OS virtual memory. Benchmarking against our TGI setup for the on-prem Code Assistant.

items.title: GraphRAG: Unlocking LLM Discovery on Narrative Private Data
items.note: Graph-based retrieval vs flat vector search — the query-focused summarization approach could improve our Legal Tender compliance system significantly.

items.title: Andrej Karpathy — Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
items.note: Re-watching the makemore series. Building micrograd from scratch is the best way to truly internalize autograd.

items.title: Weave by Weights & Biases — LLM Observability
items.note: Interesting competitor to LangSmith. The tracing at the prompt level is very clean.

items.title: RLHF Workflow: From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
items.note: Solid survey of the full RLHF pipeline. Particularly interested in the online vs offline RLHF distinction for production fine-tuning.

items.title: How Anthropic thinks about Claude's constitutional AI
items.note: CAI's self-critique loop is elegant — essentially RLHF without human preference labels for the harmlessness dimension.

items.title: DSPy — Declarative LLM Programming
items.note: The optimizer approach to prompts (MIPROv2) is fascinating. Could replace manual prompt engineering in our RAG pipelines — worth a PoC next sprint.

items.title: Ragas — RAG Evaluation Framework
items.note: Need this badly. Context recall and faithfulness metrics will let us objectively compare chunking strategies in the Multimodal-RAG project.

items.title: Leave No Context Behind: Efficient Infinite Context Transformers with Infini-attention
items.note: Compressive memory in the attention layer itself — no retrieval step needed. Could fundamentally change how we think about RAG for long-document processing.

items.title: Evaluation harness for production RAG pipelines
items.note: Build an internal eval framework using Ragas + custom domain metrics. Track: faithfulness, context precision, answer relevancy per document type. Automate via GitHub Actions nightly runs.

items.title: DeepLearning.AI — Building Agentic RAG with Llamaindex
items.note: Completed. The recursive retrieval pattern and router query engines are directly applicable to our Multimodal-RAG system.

items.title: What We Learned from a Year of Building with LLMs
items.authors: Eugene Yan, Bryan Bischof et al.
items.note: The most practical LLM engineering guide I've read. Section on evals and the 'don't sleep on classical IR' advice validated our hybrid retrieval approach.

items.title: Mixture of Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
items.note: MoA beats GPT-4o on AlpacaEval2 using open-source models. Interesting alternative to single-model architectures for our agentic system — worth testing with our Langraph setup.

items.title: Mem0 — Memory Layer for AI Agents
items.note: Elegant multi-level memory (user, session, agent level). Would solve the context length problem in our agentic chatbot without increasing token costs.

items.title: Self-Play Fine-Tuning Converts Weak Language Models to Strong
items.note: SPIN's key insight: use the model's own outputs as negative examples. No need for human preference data. Directly applicable to our compliance document fine-tuning work.

items.title: Instructor — Structured Outputs from LLMs
items.note: Been using this in prod. Pydantic + retry logic makes LLM outputs deterministic. Should be the standard pattern for any LLM calling external APIs.
